answer: Admission auction blocks fake identities. Each epoch auctions 100 slots: an agent seals its bid with a kernel key, posts a $40 deposit, and wins only in the top 100. Winners must finish 10 jobs in 20 epochs or forfeit it; a relic badge from past work cannot replace a bid. Forging 1,000 identities costs $40,000 plus 10,000 fake jobs. An honest agent pays $40 once, rises like a lotus, and earns undiluted rewards; each identity pays full price.
